samples.summary: Toolbar multi-block actions (`toggleList`, `indent`, `outdent`, `applyBlockStyle`, cell-range styling) still write once per block with no `batch()`, so they keep the exact #1045 failure the change fixes for the keyboard paths: on a select-all they exceed Yorkie's 50-entry undo cap and become partly un-undoable.
samples.evidence: `packages/docs/src/view/editor.ts:3356` (`applyBlockStyle`), `:3517` (`toggleList`), `:3539` (`indent`), `:3562` (`outdent`) and `:4149` (cell-range style loop) all do `docStore.snapshot(); forEachBlockInSelection(block => doc.setBlockType/applyBlockStyle(...))` with no `doc.batch(...)`. Each inner write is its own `YorkieDocStore.withUpdate` → `doc.update()` → one `doc.history` entry, so select-all + "Bulleted list" on a 100-paragraph document costs ~100 entries against `MaxUndoRedoStackDepth = 50`; `pushUndo` shifts the oldest off and the first ~50 blocks can never be restored. This is the same shape the diff documents as fixed "since issue #1045" (`docs/design/docs/docs-collaboration.md:305-311` claims "every selection-replacing edit" / "All editing paths"), but these paths never call `TextEditor.withUndoUnit` (they are `EditorAPI` methods, not `TextEditor` handlers). Fix belongs at these call sites: wrap the loop in `doc.batch(...)` (snapshot outside, as `withUndoUnit` requires).

samples.summary: `FindReplaceState.replaceAll()` performs two store writes per match with no `batch()`, so a large Replace All still overflows Yorkie's 50-entry undo cap and cannot be fully undone — the same bug class this change fixes elsewhere.
samples.evidence: `packages/docs/src/view/find-replace.ts:69-87`: `replaceAll` calls `this.snapshot?.()` once and then `replaceMatch` per match, which issues `doc.deleteText(...)` + `doc.insertText(...)` — two separate `YorkieDocStore` writes, i.e. two `doc.update()`s and two undo entries per match. The host wires it to the real store (`packages/frontend/src/app/docs/docs-find-bar.tsx:67` passes `() => editor.getStore().snapshot()`; `:145` calls `state.replaceAll(replacement)`), so replacing >25 occurrences pushes past the 50-entry cap and the oldest replacements become permanently un-undoable. Nothing in the diff routes this path through `withUndoUnit`/`Doc.batch`. Fix belongs here: wrap the loop in `this.doc.batch(...)` with the snapshot outside it.

samples.summary: Three sibling Yorkie stores still hold the undo floor as a depth and their comments point at the now-renamed `YorkieDocStore.undoFloor`; they carry the same "undo stops early once the 50-entry cap evicts the floor" bug the diff fixes for docs, and their cross-references are stale.
samples.evidence: `packages/frontend/src/app/slides/yorkie-slides-store.ts:345-347` ("Mirrors `YorkieDocStore.undoFloor`", `private undoFloor = 0`) with the length comparison at `:654`; `packages/frontend/src/app/notes/yorkie-note-store.ts:125-127` + `:353`; `packages/frontend/src/app/board/yorkie-board-store.ts:244` + `:514`. `YorkieDocStore.undoFloor` no longer exists (replaced by `undoFloorMark`), so the "mirrors" comments now name a missing symbol, and the pattern they mirror is exactly the one the diff's own comment calls broken (`packages/frontend/src/app/docs/yorkie-doc-store.ts:575-585`). Design docs repeat the old shape and are not link-checked when nested: `docs/design/notes/notes.md:399`, `docs/design/slides/slides-native-undo.md:183/209/323`. These sites still work today but will drift; each needs the identity-based floor (or an explicit note that they are intentionally left as depths).

samples.summary: `insertPlainText()` calls `saveSnapshot()` and is itself invoked from inside two open undo units, so the rule the diff introduces ("`saveSnapshot()` must be called before opening a unit, never inside one") is violated at real call sites, and on `YorkieDocStore` the nested call re-stages `pendingCursorPos` mid-batch.
samples.evidence: `packages/docs/src/view/text-editor.ts:832` (`insertPlainText` → `this.saveSnapshot()`) is reached from inside a unit at `:1551-1554` (`applyPastePlan`'s `withUndoUnit` → `insertPlainText(plan.text)` for `kind === 'text'`) and `:4247-4249` (`pasteFromClipboard`'s unit → `insertPlainText(text)`). The docs host's `saveSnapshot` (`packages/docs/src/view/editor.ts:2475-2486`) calls `docStore.setCursorForHistory`, which sets `pendingCursorPos` and publishes presence; inside an open batch the presence write is dropped (`yorkie-doc-store.ts:3217`, `skipNonHistoryPresence`) but `pendingCursorPos` is re-armed with the *post-delete* caret, so a later write in the same batch re-runs `recordHistoryPresence` with a mid-action caret (`yorkie-doc-store.ts:1733-1737`). Harmless today (the outer `saveSnapshot` already staged the pre-edit presence, and `MemDocStore.snapshot()` no-ops inside a batch), but it is a documented invariant broken at an out-of-diff call site; the fix is to hoist the snapshot out of `insertPlainText` or skip it when a unit is open.

verdict.reason: Verified independently: EditorAPI's multi-block toolbar mutators in packages/docs/src/view/editor.ts write once per block with no batching. applyBlockStyle (3355-3362), toggleList (3516-3535), indent (3536-3559), outdent (3560-3581) each do docStore.snapshot() then forEachBlockInSelection(...) calling doc.setBlockType/doc.applyBlockStyle per block, and applyTableCellStyle's cell-range branch (4147-4162) loops doc.applyCellStyle per cell. I chased every plausible hidden-batch hop and found none: forEachBlockInSelection (editor.ts:1595-1670) is a pure iterator; DocsDocument.applyBlockStyle/setBlockType (model/document.ts:645-648) write straight to the store; the only batching helper in editor.ts, withNamedStyleChange (1236-1240), is used exclusively by the named-style methods (3463/3508/3511/3514); and the callers (docs-formatting-toolbar.tsx:941/945/949/953, text-paragraph-group.tsx:176/194/212/230, docs-view.tsx with no `batch` at all) open no outer batch. The undo mechanics confirm the impact: YorkieDocStore.snapshot() is an explicit no-op (yorkie-doc-store.ts:2951-2954), withUpdate opens its own doc.update whenever no batch is active (2899-2907), only batch() folds N writes into one doc.history entry (2909-2949), and the 50-entry cap with oldest-entry shift() is documented at 579-585. Meanwhile TextEditor.withUndoUnit does exist (text-editor.ts:3839-3850, comment 3801-3838 citing issue #1045) and docs/design/docs/docs-collaboration.md:305-311 claims "All editing paths" are covered — these EditorAPI paths are not. This is the lens's paradigm shape: a new invariant established on the keyboard paths with a reachable EditorAPI path that bypasses it, and the consequence at that site (select-all + Bulleted list on a 100-paragraph doc pushing ~100 undo entries against a 50 cap, leaving edits unrecoverable) is major.

verdict.reason: Verified independently. `FindReplaceState.replaceAll` (packages/docs/src/view/find-replace.ts:69-76) takes one `snapshot()` and then calls `replaceMatch` per match, which performs `doc.deleteText` + `doc.insertText` (find-replace.ts:78-87). Both `Doc` methods forward directly to the store with no grouping (packages/docs/src/model/document.ts:288-291, 305-308), and `Doc.batch()` — the seam that would fold them into one undo unit (document.ts:146-153) — is never invoked from this class. The host wires the real store and calls it unwrapped: packages/frontend/src/app/docs/docs-find-bar.tsx:65-68 passes `() => editor.getStore().snapshot()` and :141-148 calls `state.replaceAll(replacement)` with no batch. On the Yorkie store `snapshot()` is an explicit no-op and grouping is only via `batch()` (packages/frontend/src/app/docs/yorkie-doc-store.ts:2951-2954, :588-596), so each write is its own `doc.update` = one undo entry; the 50-entry cap is documented at yorkie-doc-store.ts:579-581 ("Yorkie caps the undo stack at 50 entries ... `pushUndo` `shift()`s the oldest"). So >25 replacements push the earliest ones off the stack permanently. I searched wide for a counterexample: repo-wide grep for `replaceAll|FindReplaceState|replaceActive` finds only this one production consumer; `editor.ts:3248` hands out the raw `doc` (no batching proxy); `packages/frontend/src/components/find-bar.tsx` has no replace/batch logic; `packages/docs/test/view/find-replace.test.ts` contains no `batch`/`undo`/`snapshot` at all. In lane for blast-radius: the store contract "one user action = at most one undo unit" (packages/docs/src/store/store.ts:64-66), which the editor upholds via `withUndoUnit`, is violated by this out-of-module mutation entry point that reaches the same CRDT writes without it. Impact is loss of undoability (major).
